registries.label: Reaction Mining
registries.intro: Start from substrates, products, reaction SMILES, EC numbers, or names and retrieve enzyme candidates.

tools.name: Direct Reaction-to-Enzyme
tools.introduction: Retrieve proteins directly from reaction-conditioned evidence.
tools.description: Runnable catalog baseline and extension point for CLIP-style retrieval.

tools.name: EnzymeMap Reaction Database
tools.introduction: Load standardized and atom-mapped EnzymeMap reaction tables.
tools.description: Auto-detects published CSV/TSV fields and records versioned checksum provenance.

tools.name: Exact Reaction Search
tools.introduction: Resolve exact normalized reactions to annotated enzyme records.
tools.description: The runnable local baseline behind the exact-reaction Harness route.

tools.name: Reaction Similarity Search
tools.introduction: Retrieve chemically related reaction records before enzyme expansion.
tools.description: Runnable lexical baseline with a stable route for DRFP/RXNFP/CGR providers.

tools.name: Reaction-to-EC
tools.introduction: Infer candidate EC classes from annotated related reactions.
tools.description: Runnable catalog baseline and extension point for learned reaction-to-EC models.

tools.name: Reaction-to-Enzyme Mining
tools.introduction: Search exact and similar reactions, infer EC classes, and rank enzyme candidates.
tools.description: Runs the ZymeForge reaction standardizer, exact search, similarity search, reaction-to-EC, direct reaction-to-enzyme retrieval, and evidence fusion workflow.

tools.name: Rhea Reaction Database
tools.introduction: Load versioned Rhea reaction exports with EC and UniProt links.
tools.description: Preserves source version, checksum, row provenance, and normalized cross-links.

tools.name: Substrate-to-Enzyme Mining
tools.introduction: Resolve SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, or names and retrieve linked enzymes.
tools.description: Runs the configured substrate-to-enzyme provider and returns normalized candidate, EC, reaction, confidence, source, and provenance fields.

registries.label: Sequence Search
registries.intro: Search sequence space with alignment, profile, and protein language model evidence.

tools.name: DHR Retrieval
tools.introduction: Retrieve remote homologs with dedicated asymmetric encoders.
tools.description: Official DHR query encoder against target-encoder database vectors.

tools.name: ESM-2 Retrieval
tools.introduction: Retrieve proteins by ESM-2 sequence-semantic similarity.
tools.description: Batched 650M embeddings, content cache, and Flat/HNSW retrieval.

tools.name: HHsearch Profile Search
tools.introduction: Retrieve remote homologs by profile-profile comparison.
tools.description: Preserves HHsearch probability, E-value, P-value, score, and aligned columns.

tools.name: MMseqs2 Sequence Search
tools.introduction: Run high-throughput sequence alignment against a configured protein database.
tools.description: Returns identity, query/target coverage, E-value, bit score, and alignment length.

tools.name: ProTrek Retrieval
tools.introduction: Search proteins from sequence, structure, or natural-language text.
tools.description: Tri-modal ProTrek shared-space retrieval with modality provenance.

tools.name: TM-Vec Retrieval
tools.introduction: Find structural neighbors directly from protein sequence.
tools.description: Published ProtT5-to-TM-Vec 512D structure-oriented retrieval.

tools.name: phmmer Sequence Search
tools.introduction: Search protein sequences with HMMER profile-HMM scoring.
tools.description: Parses domain-table output while retaining native E-values, scores, and coverage.

registries.label: Structure Search
registries.intro: Compare global folds and local catalytic geometry to recover remote enzyme relationships.

tools.name: Active-site Geometry Validation
tools.introduction: Compare catalytic residues and pocket geometry independently of global fold.
tools.description: Returns catalytic RMSD, distances, angles, conservation, and local pLDDT.

tools.name: DALI Validation
tools.introduction: Validate only the top retrieved structures using DALI Z-scores.
tools.description: Returns Z-score, RMSD, aligned length, identity, and protein lengths.

tools.name: EC-LMGraph
tools.description: EC-LMGraph catalytic-site prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Identify residues and local geometry that support catalysis.

tools.name: Foldseek Retrieval
tools.introduction: Search structures by 3Di and amino-acid local alignment.
tools.description: Preserves identity, coverage, E-value, bit score, TM-scores, and lDDT.

tools.name: GraphEC-AS
tools.description: GraphEC-AS catalytic-site prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Identify residues and local geometry that support catalysis.

tools.name: Ligand and Metal Geometry Analysis
tools.introduction: Inspect ligand contacts, clashes, hydrogen bonds, and metal coordination.
tools.description: Keeps contact residues and external pocket-volume/BSA evidence separate.

tools.name: ProteinMPNN Encoder Retrieval
tools.introduction: Experimental retrieval from final ProteinMPNN backbone encoder states.
tools.description: Chain-level, mean-pooled 128D backbone representation.

tools.name: SaProt Retrieval
tools.introduction: Retrieve proteins using amino-acid and 3Di structural context.
tools.description: Structure-aware SaProt embeddings with explicit structure provenance.

tools.name: US-align / TM-align Comparison
tools.introduction: Validate global fold preservation with pairwise structural alignment.
tools.description: Returns both normalized TM-scores, RMSD, aligned length, and identity.

registries.label: Function Prediction
registries.intro: Profile EC function, catalytic sites, substrate compatibility, kinetics, stability, and developability.

tools.name: CLEAN
tools.description: CLEAN enzyme function and EC prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Predict EC numbers and enzyme function from a protein sequence.

tools.name: CataPro
tools.description: CataPro kcat, Km, and catalytic-efficiency prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Estimate catalytic parameters for an enzyme-substrate pair.

tools.name: DISCODE
tools.description: DISCODE cofactor-specificity prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Predict cofactor preference such as NAD, NADP, or FAD.

tools.name: DeepLoc
tools.description: DeepLoc subcellular-localization prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Predict cellular localization for developability triage.

tools.name: DeepSTABp
tools.description: DeepSTABp protein melting-temperature prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Estimate melting temperature or thermostability probability.

tools.name: DeepTMHMM
tools.description: DeepTMHMM transmembrane-topology prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Detect transmembrane regions and topology.

tools.name: EC-LMGraph
tools.description: EC-LMGraph EC and enzyme-function prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Predict EC numbers and enzyme function from a protein sequence.

tools.name: ESP
tools.description: ESP enzyme–substrate pair prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Estimate whether a candidate enzyme can accept a target substrate.

tools.name: EZSpecificity
tools.description: EZSpecificity substrate-specificity prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Estimate whether a candidate enzyme can accept a target substrate.

tools.name: EpHod
tools.description: EpHod enzyme optimum-pH prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Predict the pH optimum for enzyme activity.

tools.name: HIT-EC
tools.description: HIT-EC hierarchical enzyme function prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Predict EC numbers and enzyme function from a protein sequence.

tools.name: INSIGHT
tools.description: INSIGHT cofactor-specificity prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Predict cofactor preference such as NAD, NADP, or FAD.

tools.name: NetSolP
tools.description: NetSolP protein solubility prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Estimate whether a protein is likely to remain soluble.

tools.name: OphPred
tools.description: OphPred optimum-pH prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Predict the pH optimum for enzyme activity.

tools.name: ProSmith
tools.description: ProSmith enzyme–substrate compatibility adapter.
tools.introduction: Estimate whether a candidate enzyme can accept a target substrate.

tools.name: SignalP
tools.description: SignalP signal-peptide prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Detect signal peptides and likely cleavage sites.

tools.name: TemBERTure
tools.description: TemBERTure protein thermostability prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Estimate melting temperature or thermostability probability.

tools.name: TemStaPro
tools.description: TemStaPro protein thermostability prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Estimate melting temperature or thermostability probability.

tools.name: TurNuP
tools.description: TurNuP enzyme turnover-number prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Estimate catalytic parameters for an enzyme-substrate pair.

tools.name: UniKP
tools.description: UniKP enzyme kinetic-parameter prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Estimate catalytic parameters for an enzyme-substrate pair.

registries.label: Structure Prediction
registries.intro: Generate protein and complex structures for pocket inspection, docking, and consistency checks.

tools.name: AlphaFold 3 Local Prediction
tools.introduction: Local AF3 prediction for proteins, ligands, and nucleic acids.
tools.description: Enabled only with legally provisioned local parameters and databases.

tools.name: Boltz-2 Structure Prediction
tools.introduction: Predict proteins, complexes, and protein-ligand structures with Boltz-2.
tools.description: Preserves confidence, complex confidence, affinity output, and provenance.

tools.name: ESMFold Fast Screening
tools.introduction: Fast single-protein prediction for large candidate screens.
tools.description: Retains mean and per-residue pLDDT, pTM, runtime, and checkpoint hash.

tools.name: MolProbity Structure QC
tools.introduction: Run mature structural quality checks after prediction.
tools.description: Reports clashes, Ramachandran outliers, geometry errors, and chain issues.

registries.label: Engineering
registries.intro: Move from a selected enzyme to targeted mutation optimization or sequence redesign.

tools.name: GeoStab
tools.description: GeoStab mutation stability-effect prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Estimate stability and fitness effects of a proposed mutation.

tools.name: LigandMPNN Sequence Redesign
tools.introduction: Redesign a complete scaffold or selected pocket residues while preserving catalytic, ligand, membrane, and symmetry constraints.
tools.description: One official wrapper for ProteinMPNN, LigandMPNN, SolubleMPNN, global-label membrane MPNN, per-residue membrane MPNN, score.py, and side-chain packing.

tools.name: LigandMPNN Sequence Scoring
tools.introduction: Compare native, mutant, and designed sequences on matched backbones and ligand contexts.
tools.description: Official score.py integration for autoregressive, single-AA, sequence-conditioned, and backbone-only scoring.

tools.name: ThermoMPNN
tools.description: ThermoMPNN mutation thermostability prediction adapter.
tools.introduction: Estimate stability and fitness effects of a proposed mutation.

tools.name: unZipro Mutation Prediction
tools.introduction: Prioritize function-oriented single substitutions for a selected protein.
tools.description: Calls official unZipro inference, preserves its native probabilities and logits, and maps ranked predictions into ZymeForge candidates.

registries.label: Evidence Fusion
registries.intro: Calibrate heterogeneous evidence into an explainable ZymeScore and candidate ranking.

tools.name: Reciprocal Rank Fusion
tools.introduction: Merge independent retrieval rankings without mixing native scores.
tools.description: Optional RRF over canonicalized similarity hits.

tools.name: Weighted Evidence Fusion
tools.introduction: Combine calibrated evidence with explicit per-channel contributions.
tools.description: Runnable transparent baseline used by the reaction-mining workflow.

tools.name: ZymeScore Candidate Ranking
tools.introduction: Rank unified Candidates while preserving all source evidence.
tools.description: Harness candidate-ranking tool using ZymeScore or available evidence.

registries.label: Output
registries.intro: Export candidates, evidence, score cards, and provenance for downstream analysis.

tools.name: Candidate TSV Writer
tools.introduction: Export flattened candidate tables for downstream analysis.
tools.description: Built-in tab-separated candidate writer.

tools.name: Harness Run Artifacts
tools.introduction: Persist plans, tool results, candidates, provenance, and HTML reports.
tools.description: Reproducible seven-artifact Harness run directory.

tools.name: JSON Result Writer
tools.introduction: Write complete typed results and provenance as portable JSON.
tools.description: Built-in output writer for workflows and APIs.
